risks.title: Potential impact of tariffs on margins
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned in the context of gross margins for 2026, with cautious language (could impact) and quantitative basis (net margins declining from program estimates). Macro category weighted moderately. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Valuation allowance tax risk
risks.score_rationale: Text mentions continuous monitoring of deferred tax asset realization and explicit risk of valuation allowance establishment if forecasts change. Strong language (changes could lead) and significant financial impact. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on external financing
risks.score_rationale: Liquidity relies on cash, debt, and instruments such as shelf registration. While sufficient for 12 months, dependence is highlighted as critical. Repetitive and structural language. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Repeated restructurings affecting costs
risks.score_rationale: Restructuring charges are recurring (2024 and 2025), with impacts on headcount and expenses. In 2024, 150 positions eliminated for $9.5M in charges; in 2025, 145 positions eliminated for $4.9M with expected annualized savings of $15M. Phenomenon is persistent. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and legal costs on the rise
risks.score_rationale: Increase in litigation and settlement expenses ($9.9M in 2025). Explicit mention of costs related to class actions and litigation with former CEO. Language intensity moderate but recurrent presence. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of cash flow interruption in case of government crisis
risks.score_rationale: Text cites proactive debt modification in response to uncertainty related to government shutdown. Amendment No. 5 in November 2023 raised covenant leverage ratio from 4.50 to 5.25. Cautious language but revealing of systemic exposure. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Binding purchase obligations
risks.score_rationale: Non-cancelable purchase commitments of $206.4M, of which $50M related to Cicor following the sale of Swiss manufacturing operations in April 2025. High amount but without indication of current stress. Industrial category weighted moderately. (default score, to be refined)
